requirements.subject: left lane closure
requirements.relation: uses channelizing devices along both the center line and adjacent lane
requirements.threshold: required for a single left-lane closure on an undivided road
applicability_conditions: closed lane is the left lane
required_inputs: visual confirmation of device lines along center line and adjacent lane
requirements.source_span: When only the left-hand lane is closed on undivided roads, channelizing devices shall be placed along the center line as well as along the adjacent lane.

requirements.subject: lane closure
requirements.relation: has a transition area containing a merging taper
requirements.threshold: required for a non-mobile lane closure on a multilane road
required_inputs: visual confirmation of transition and merging taper
requirements.source_span: When a lane is closed on a multi-lane road for other than a mobile operation, a transition area containing a merging taper shall be used.

requirements.subject: work-zone layout
requirements.relation: matches the selected interior lane closure arrangement
requirements.threshold: left lane closed with warning, transition, optional buffer, and work-space elements arranged as TA-30
requirements.source_span: This information applies to low-speed, low-volume urban streets. Where speed or volume is higher, additional signing such as LEFT LANE CLOSED XX FT should be used between the signs shown.

requirements.subject: advance warning system
requirements.relation: provides a Lane(s) Closed sign in advance of the closed through lane
requirements.threshold: sign present and legend identifies the left lane for a single-lane closure
applicability_conditions: one or more through lanes of a multilane roadway are closed
requirements.source_span: The Lane(s) Closed sign (see Figure 6H-1) shall be used in advance of that point where one or more through lanes of a multi-lane roadway are closed.

requirements.subject: advance warning signs
requirements.relation: places ROAD WORK AHEAD as the first advance warning sign encountered
requirements.threshold: first in sequence when multiple advance warning signs are used
applicability_conditions: multiple advance warning signs are present
requirements.source_span: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.

requirements.subject: advance warning signs
requirements.relation: maintains recommended minimum A, B, and C spacing
requirements.threshold: at least 100 ft between successive signs for urban low-speed context
requirements.source_span: Table 6B-1. Recommended Advance Warning Sign Minimum Spacing. Urban (low speed): 100 feet, 100 feet, 100 feet. Urban (high speed): 350 feet, 350 feet, 350 feet. Rural: 500 feet, 500 feet, 500 feet. Expressway / Freeway: 1,000 feet, 1,500 feet, 2,640 feet. The column headings A, B, and C are the dimensions shown in Figures 6P-1 through 6P-54.

requirements.subject: channelizing devices
requirements.relation: maintain spacing no greater than the applicable speed-based maximum
requirements.threshold: taper spacing ≤ 1× posted speed and tangent spacing ≤ 2× posted speed; at 30 mph, 30 ft taper and 60 ft tangent
applicability_conditions: channelizing devices are used in the closure
requirements.source_span: The spacing between cones, tubular markers, vertical panels, drums, and barricades should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 1 times the speed limit in mph when used for taper channelization, and should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 2 times the speed limit in mph when used for tangent channelization.

measurement_spec.quantity: maximum spacing between successive channelizing devices by taper or tangent segment

requirements.subject: channelizing devices
requirements.relation: replace devices that are no longer serviceable
requirements.threshold: all deployed devices are serviceable and do not require replacement
requirements.source_span: Channelizing devices that are no longer serviceable (see definition in Section 1C.02) shall be replaced.

requirements.subject: Particular attention
requirements.threshold: Particular attention should be given to maintaining the channelizing devices to keep them clean, visible, and properly positioned at all times.
requirements.source_span: Particular attention should be given to maintaining the channelizing devices to keep them clean, visible, and properly positioned at all times.

requirements.subject: taper length L
requirements.threshold: For S of 40 mph or less, L = W*S^2/60; for S of 45 mph or more, L = W*S.
applicability_conditions: a taper using dimension L is shown or required
requirements.source_span: Table 6B-4. Formulas for Determining Taper Length. 40 mph or less: L = WS2/60. 45 mph or more: L = WS. Where L is taper length in feet, W is width of offset in feet, and S is posted speed limit, off-peak 85th-percentile speed prior to work starting, or anticipated operating speed in mph.

measurement_spec.quantity: merging taper length versus calculated L

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6L.06 03: If used, an arrow board
requirements.subject: If used, an arrow board
requirements.threshold: If used, an arrow board should be used in combination with appropriate signs, channelizing devices, or other TTC devices.
requirements.source_span: If used, an arrow board should be used in combination with appropriate signs, channelizing devices, or other TTC devices.

requirements.subject: An arrow board
requirements.threshold: An arrow board should be placed on the shoulder of the roadway or, if practicable, farther from the traveled lane. It should be delineated with retroreflective TTC devices. When an arrow board is not being used, it should be removed; if not removed, it should be shielded; or if the previous two options are not feasible, it should be delineated with retroreflective TTC devices.
requirements.source_span: An arrow board should be placed on the shoulder of the roadway or, if practicable, farther from the traveled lane. It should be delineated with retroreflective TTC devices. requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.02 01: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs
requirements.subject: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs
requirements.threshold: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs should be placed in advance of the transition and activity areas at varying distances depending on roadway type, condition, and posted speed. Table 6B-1 contains information regarding the spacing of advance warning signs. Where a series of two or more advance warning signs is used, the closest sign to the transition and activity areas should be placed approximately 100 feet for low-speed urban streets to 1,000 feet or more for freeways and expressways.
requirements.source_span: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs should be placed in advance of the transition and activity areas at varying distances depending on roadway type, condition, and posted speed. Table 6B-1 contains information regarding the spacing of advance warning signs. Where a series of two or more advance warning signs is used, the closest sign to the transition and activity areas should be placed approximately 100 feet for low-speed urban streets to 1,000 feet or more for freeways and expressways.

measurement_spec.quantity: closest advance warning sign distance upstream of transition/activity area

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6L.06 17: An arrow board in the arrow or chevron mode
requirements.subject: An arrow board in the arrow or chevron mode
requirements.threshold: An arrow board in the arrow or chevron mode shall be used only for stationary or moving lane closures on multi-lane roadways.
requirements.source_span: An arrow board in the arrow or chevron mode shall be used only for stationary or moving lane closures on multi-lane roadways.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.03 01: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions
requirements.subject: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions,
requirements.threshold: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions, should be located in advance of the work space or any detour, on the road where the work is taking place.
requirements.source_span: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions, should be located in advance of the work space or any detour, on the road where the work is taking place.

requirements.subject: A merging taper
requirements.threshold: A merging taper should be long enough to enable merging drivers to have adequate advance warning and sufficient length to adjust their speeds and merge into an adjacent lane before the downstream end of the transition.
requirements.source_span: A merging taper should be long enough to enable merging drivers to have adequate advance warning and sufficient length to adjust their speeds and merge into an adjacent lane before the downstream end of the transition.

requirements.subject: Arrow boards
requirements.threshold: Arrow boards shall only be used to indicate a lane closure. Arrow boards shall not be used to indicate a lane shift.
requirements.source_span: Arrow boards shall only be used to indicate a lane closure. Arrow boards shall not be used to indicate a lane shift.

requirements.subject: The appropriate taper length (L)
requirements.threshold: The appropriate taper length (L) should 60 be determined using the criteria shown in 45 mph or more L = WS Tables 6B-3 and 6B-4. Where: L = taper length in feet Support: W = width of offset in feet A merging taper requires the longest distance S = posted speed limit, or off‑peak 85th‑percentile speed
